import java.util.*;
import java.math.BigInteger;

public class Main {

    static final int mod = 998244353;
    static long[] pw10 = new long[17];

    static String toString128(BigInteger num) {
        if (num.equals(BigInteger.ZERO))
            return "0";
        StringBuilder res = new StringBuilder();
        while (!num.equals(BigInteger.ZERO)) {
            BigInteger[] divRem = num.divideAndRemainder(BigInteger.TEN);
            res.append((char)('0' + divRem[1].intValue()));
            num = divRem[0];
        }
        return res.reverse().toString();
    }

    static long count_with_prefix(String s, long n, String n_str) {
        long ans = 0;
        long s_val = 0;
        for (char ch : s.toCharArray())
            s_val = 10 * s_val + (ch - '0');

        for (int len = s.length(); len <= n_str.length(); ++len) {
            if (len < n_str.length()) {
                ans += pw10[len - s.length()];
            } else {
                int t = comparePrefix(s, n_str);
                if (t < 0)
                    ans += pw10[len - s.length()];
                else if (t == 0) {
                    long sum = (n + 1) - s_val * pw10[n_str.length() - s.length()];
                    ans += sum;
                }
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static int comparePrefix(String s, String n_str) {
        int len = Math.min(s.length(), n_str.length());
        for (int i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
            if (s.charAt(i) != n_str.charAt(i))
                return s.charAt(i) - n_str.charAt(i);
        }
        return s.length() - n_str.length();
    }

    static void solve(List<Integer> variables, long base, BigInteger ans) {
        int until;
        int cur;
        List<Integer> rem1 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> rem2 = new ArrayList<>();

        // Generate all combinations recursively
        class BruteForce {
            void recurse(int pos, int maxPos) {
                if (pos == maxPos) {
                    rem1.add(cur);
                    return;
                }
                int oldcur = cur;
                for (int t = 0; t < 10; ++t) {
                    recurse(pos + 1, maxPos);
                    cur += variables.get(pos);
                    if (cur >= mod) cur -= mod;
                }
                cur = oldcur;
            }
        }

        cur = base;
        until = variables.size() / 2;
        new BruteForce().recurse(0, until);
        rem2.addAll(rem1);
        cur = 0;
        until = variables.size();
        new BruteForce().recurse(variables.size() / 2, until);

        Collections.sort(rem1);
        Collections.sort(rem2);

        long totalrsum = 0;
        for (int b : rem2)
            totalrsum += b;

        int j = rem2.size() - 1;
        for (int a : rem1) {
            while (j >= 0 && a + rem2.get(j) >= mod)
                j--;

            long sum = a * (long)rem2.size() + totalrsum - (rem2.size() - 1 - j) * (long)mod;
            ans = ans.add(BigInteger.valueOf(sum));
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);

        long n = sc.nextLong();

        String n_str = new StringBuilder(Long.toString(n)).reverse().toString();

        pw10[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < 17; ++i)
            pw10[i] = 10 * pw10[i - 1];

        BigInteger ans = BigInteger.ZERO;

        for (int len = 1; len <= n_str.length(); ++len) {
            long cur = 0;
            StringBuilder curst = new StringBuilder();

            for (int firstdiff = 0; firstdiff < n_str.length() && firstdiff < len; ++firstdiff) {
                if (firstdiff > 0) {
                    cur = 10 * cur + (n_str.charAt(firstdiff - 1) - '0');
                    curst.append(n_str.charAt(firstdiff - 1));
                }

                for (int lastdig = 0; lastdig <= 9; ++lastdig) {
                    if (firstdiff == 0 && lastdig == 0)
                        continue;
                    if (lastdig == (n_str.charAt(firstdiff) - '0'))
                        continue;
                    if (len == n_str.length() && lastdig > (n_str.charAt(firstdiff) - '0'))
                        continue;

                    long curp = 10 * cur + lastdig;
                    String curstp = curst.toString() + (char)('0' + lastdig);

                    long base = 0;
                    StringBuilder tmp = new StringBuilder();
                    for (int pos = 0; pos < curstp.length(); ++pos) {
                        for (char dig = (pos == 0 ? '1' : '0'); dig < curstp.charAt(pos); ++dig)
                            base += count_with_prefix(tmp.toString() + dig, n, n_str);
                        tmp.append(curstp.charAt(pos));
                    }
                    base += len - 1;

                    List<Integer> variables = new ArrayList<>();
                    for (int pos = curstp.length(); pos < len; ++pos) {
                        variables.add((int)(count_with_prefix(tmp.toString() + '0', n, n_str) % mod));
                        tmp.append('0');
                    }

                    long base_mod = base + 1 - curp * pw10[len - curstp.length()];
                    base_mod %= mod;
                    if (base_mod < 0)
                        base_mod += mod;

                    for (int i = 0; i < variables.size(); ++i) {
                        int val = variables.get(i) % mod;
                        if (val < 0) val += mod;
                        variables.set(i, val);
                    }

                    solve(variables, base_mod, ans);
                }
            }
        }

        // Handle prefix of N
        long curPrefix = 0;
        StringBuilder curstPrefix = new StringBuilder();

        for (int len = 1; len <= n_str.length(); ++len) {
            curstPrefix.append(n_str.charAt(len - 1));
            curPrefix = 10 * curPrefix + (n_str.charAt(len - 1) - '0');

            long val = 1; // 1-based
            StringBuilder tmp = new StringBuilder();

            for (int pos = 0; pos < curstPrefix.length(); ++pos) {
                for (char dig = (pos == 0 ? '1' : '0'); dig < curstPrefix.charAt(pos); ++dig)
                    val += count_with_prefix(tmp.toString() + dig, n, n_str);
                tmp.append(curstPrefix.charAt(pos));
            }
            val += len - 1;
            val -= curPrefix;
            val %= mod;
            if (val < 0) val += mod;

            ans = ans.add(BigInteger.valueOf(val));
        }

        // Final output
        final long MOD_FINAL = 1000000007;
        ans = ans.mod(BigInteger.valueOf(MOD_FINAL));
        System.out.println(toString128(ans));
        sc.close();
    }
}
